checkpoint_selection.best_validity.pt: maximum fixed validation-probe validity; ties exactness then full validation loss

chemistry_selection: fixed seeded random cohort prefixes; full validation chemistry optionally expanded at fixed epochs

provenance.canonicalization: RDKit canonical stereo-free SMILES; reparsed for ordered atom slots
provenance.deduplication: SQLite primary key on roundtrip-valid canonical identity
provenance.repairs: none; no salt stripping, charge normalization or tautomer normalization
provenance.selection_method: SHA256(seed, NUL, canonical stereo-free SMILES) rank; heldouts first
provenance.source_split_labels: ignored; this is a custom canonical-identity resplit, not an official corpus split
provenance.split_method: protected old roles then seeded rank, exact quotas; not scaffold-separated
provenance.target_validation: connected sanitized graph; exact canonical SMILES roundtrip
unsupported_features: explicit hydrogen counts that fail graph roundtrip
